name: posture-check
description: Watches your posture through the webcam and alerts you when you start to slouch

scripts.build:chrome: yarn assets && EXT_TARGET=chrome vite build && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: yarn assets && EXT_TARGET=firefox vite build && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs firefox
scripts.package:chrome: yarn build:chrome && rm -f posture-check-chrome.zip && cd dist-chrome && zip -qr ../posture-check-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: yarn build:firefox && rm -f posture-check-firefox.zip && cd dist-firefox && zip -qr ../posture-check-firefox.zip .
